text:
No option can be put forward yet, because the analysis could not test either of your decision constraints properly.

- The £20k MRR target could not be assessed: the model lacks an MRR starting level and an explicit objective direction. The “under 4% monthly churn” limit was also left unscored because churn is modelled as a calculated change rather than a comparable monthly rate.
- Within the incomplete comparison, results held up under the tested changes—but that is not evidence that any price satisfies your goal.
- Active Pro subscribers exert the largest structural influence; its value is an Olumi estimate, not a user-supplied measurement.
